summary: Make login snapshot refs unique and reject refs from earlier snapshots.

tasks.title: Version login snapshot refs
tasks.change: Add a monotonic snapshot sequence to ref ids, keep only the latest ref map while disposing older handles, and reject malformed, unknown, and older-snapshot refs with REF_STALE.
tasks.effect: Refs cannot alias controls in a later login snapshot.

verification.risk_reason: Stale refs can activate the wrong login control, so incorrect resolution can cause unintended account actions.
verification.test_reason: The focused suite lacked coverage for refs reused after controls change; the regression verifies the stale-ref failure and prevents Cancel from being clicked.
verification.subject: Snapshot-scoped login control references
verification.procedure: Run the requested focused Vitest unit files and launch-agent integration shell test.
verification.pass_criterion: The old Continue ref returns REF_STALE after a new snapshot, Cancel remains unclicked, and all requested tests pass.

verification: npx vitest run test/unit/agent-runtime.test.mjs test/unit/agent-login.test.mjs test/unit/agent-mcp.test.mjs test/unit/agent-worker.test.mjs
risks: Snapshot refs remain in-memory and are invalidated when the latest ref map is replaced.
